home.intro: Music, economy, reminders and server tools. Manage the bot on your servers from here.
home.title: Bot stats

servers.title: Servers
servers.subtitle: Servers where you can manage the bot
servers.emptyText: Servers show up here if you have the Manage Server permission on them.

members.resetMemberText: This deletes the member's money, bank, experience, level and transactions on this server.
members.resetEconomyTitle: Reset the economy of the whole server?
members.resetEconomyText: This deletes money, bank, experience, levels and transactions of everyone on {name}. You can't undo this.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.notAllowed: You or the bot can't do this: no permission or the role is too low
moderation.reasonHint: The reason goes to the server audit log with your name.

hints.welcome: Posted to the channel when someone joins. The newcomer gets pinged.
hints.goodbye: Posted to the channel when someone leaves. Nobody gets pinged.
hints.dm: Sent privately to everyone who joins. Some people have DMs closed, they won't get it.

greetings.avatar: Member's avatar next to the text
greetings.placeholders: You can use {user} (mention), {username}, {server} and {count} (member count) in the text.

starter.dm: Hi! Welcome to **{server}**, glad to have you here

greetings.autorolesHint: Given to everyone who joins, up to {max} roles. Bots don't get them. On servers with rules screening, roles come after the rules are accepted.
greetings.noRoles: The bot can't give any role. Move its role higher in the server settings.

levels.rewardsHint: Members get a reward when they reach its level: a role, credits or both.
levels.stack: Keep the roles of lower levels
levels.roleHint: If off, members only keep the role from their highest reward. You can only pick roles below the bot's top role.
levels.syncHint: Gives everyone the reward roles for the levels they already have. If the toggle above is off, lower reward roles are removed. Credits aren't paid again. Save your changes first.
levels.syncConfirm: Give out reward roles to everyone?
levels.syncConfirmText: On big servers this takes a few minutes. The bot does it in the background.
levels.syncStarted: Started for {n} member | Started for {n} members

shop.emptyText: Add roles, collectibles or boosts for members to buy with credits.
shop.search: Search by name, description or role
shop.formHint: Members see the shop with /shop and their items with /inventory.
shop.name: Name
shop.roleHint: You can only pick roles below the bot's top role.
shop.sellable: Can be sold back for half the price
shop.deleteText: It disappears from members' inventories. Roles people already bought stay.

typeHints.role: The member keeps the role forever.
typeHints.temp_role: The role is removed when time runs out. Buying again adds more time.
typeHints.item: Goes to the inventory and shows in /profile. Can be gifted.
typeHints.consumable: Goes to the inventory. Using it turns on an effect for a while.

tickets.intro: Sends a message with a button that opens a private ticket thread in that channel. The bot needs permission to create private threads there.
tickets.textPlaceholder: Need help? Open a ticket and we'll get back to you.
tickets.label: Button text

messages.textPlaceholder: Text, Discord markdown works: **bold**, # heading, -# small text

audit.emptyText: Changes made in the dashboard show up here.

actions.economy.reset: reset the economy of the server

music.joinToControl: Join the voice channel {channel} to control the music
music.cantControl: Join the bot's voice channel to control the music
music.nothingText: Add a track below and the bot will join your voice channel.
music.joinToStart: Join a voice channel on the server to start the music.
music.saveQueueText: The current track and the whole queue go to the end of the playlist.
music.savedToPlaylist: Saved {n} track to {title} | Saved {n} tracks to {title}

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.notFound: No lyrics found for this track

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.subtitle: Your playlists, they work on any server with the bot
playlists.emptyText: Create one on the left and add tracks to it.
playlists.noTracks: No tracks yet. Add a link or search for something above.
playlists.skipped: {n} track didn't fit, the playlist is full | {n} tracks didn't fit, the playlist is full
playlists.howToPlay: To play it, open the Music tab on a server or use {command} in Discord.
playlists.deleteText: The playlist and all of its tracks will be gone.
playlists.uploadHint: You have {max} MB for uploads. Formats: {formats}. Files not played for 2 weeks are deleted.
playlists.fileExpired: Deleted after 2 weeks without plays. Upload it again or remove it
playlists.fileExpires: Will be deleted {time} if not played
playlists.fileExpiresHint: Each play resets the 2 week timer
playlists.filesUnavailable: {n} uploaded file was deleted after 2 weeks without plays. Upload it again on the Playlists page | {n} uploaded files were deleted after 2 weeks without plays. Upload them again on the Playlists page
playlists.dropBusy: Wait for the current upload to finish

leaderboard.title: Reputation
leaderboard.subtitle: Top 50 by reputation across all servers

profile.bioPlaceholder: A few words about yourself, shown in /profile
profile.birthdateHint: The bot congratulates you on servers that have birthday announcements on.
profile.remindsHint: The bot sends them to your DMs, like /remindme
profile.economyHint: Your balance and level on servers with the bot
profile.noEconomy: You don't have any economy data yet

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.hint: While it's on, the bot tells everyone but you that it's under maintenance.

status.title: Bot status
status.hint: Replaces the rotating status. Leave empty to bring the rotation back.

servers.leaveText: The bot leaves the server, its data stays in the database.
servers.blacklistText: The bot leaves the server and will leave again every time it's added.

stats.emptyText: Commands are counted since this version and saved once a minute.

blacklist.hint: Blacklisted users and servers can't use commands. The bot leaves blacklisted servers.
